description: This file defines the Session class for managing user sessions within the Goteo application, utilizing Symfony's HTTP foundation components. It includes session initialization, expiration handling, user management, and menu management functionalities.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: A class for managing user sessions, including initialization, expiration, user data, and menu management within the Goteo application.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Initializes session management with an optional Symfony Request object.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns the current session object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setSessionExpires
methods.description: Sets the session expiration time in seconds.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the session start time.

methods.name: getSessionExpires
methods.description: Returns the session expiration time.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the session start time or current microtime if not set.

methods.name: expiresIn
methods.description: Calculates remaining time before session expiration.

methods.name: renew
methods.description: Extends the session by updating the init_time.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new session with a given name and optional session time.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID, handling migration if necessary.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the current session and triggers callback if set.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the session.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the session by key.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all session data.

methods.name: getAndDel
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a session value by key.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Removes a key from the session.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the session.

methods.name: onSessionExpires
methods.description: Sets a callback to execute when the session expires automatically.

methods.name: onSessionDestroyed
methods.description: Sets a callback to execute when the session is destroyed.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Stores a User object in the session, optionally setting a cookie.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Checks if a user is logged in.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the logged-in user has admin privileges.

methods.name: isModuleAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the user has admin rights for a specific module.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the logged-in user, or false if not logged in.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User object of the logged-in user, or null if not logged in.

methods.name: addToMenu
methods.description: Adds an item to a specified menu array.

methods.name: delMenuPosition
methods.description: Removes a menu item at a specified position.

methods.name: addToMainMenu
methods.description: Adds an item to the main menu.

methods.name: addToUserMenu
methods.description: Adds an item to the user menu.

methods.name: addToSidebarMenu
methods.description: Adds an item to the sidebar menu.

methods.name: getMainMenu
methods.description: Returns the main menu items.

methods.name: getUserMenu
methods.description: Returns the user menu items.

methods.name: getSidebarMenu
methods.description: Returns the sidebar menu items.

methods.name: delMainMenuPosition
methods.description: Deletes a menu item at a specific position in the main menu.

methods.name: delUserMenuPosition
methods.description: Deletes a menu item at a specific position in the user menu.

methods.name: delSidebarMenuPosition
methods.description: Deletes a menu item at a specific position in the sidebar menu.
